title: Athlone (Bokmakierie St and 7th Ave): man, 35, shot dead in a car, 19 Oct
summary: Police say a man of 35 was found with multiple gunshot wounds inside a vehicle at the corner of Bokmakierie Street and 7th Avenue after a shooting at about 13:25 on Monday 19 October (Constable Ndakhe Gwala, via Daily Vo...
story: Police say a man of 35 was found with multiple gunshot wounds inside a vehicle at the corner of Bokmakierie Street and 7th Avenue after a shooting at about 13:25 on Monday 19 October (Constable Ndakhe Gwala, via Daily Voice). He was declared dead at the scene. Athlone police registered a murder case; police believe the motive is gang-related. No arrest has been reported. The victim was not named. SABC News (citing police) and Megazone say Monday night; the police statement quoted by Daily Voice gives about 13:25, and Heart FM says the afternoon. Four reports, all resting on one police account: SABC News, Heart FM, Daily Voice and Crime Scene Report (news-stuff.co.za).
incident: Mon 19 Oct 2026 at about 13:25 (police statement, via Daily Voice and Crime Scene Report). SABC News and Megazone say Monday night.
location_note: Inside a vehicle at the corner of Bokmakierie Street and 7th Avenue (police, via Daily Voice; Heart FM). The pin is the shared node of the two streets in OpenStreetMap.
